title: a one-component inspector run clears no finding trouble
intention: A build-inspector run over one component clears no finding trouble; only a run that saw every component reconciles.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: _main in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py narrows inspect to the named component, then reconciles the whole inspector-new-finding- prefix against those findings. A finding trouble is one per sieve (cd27b72ba964), so a sieve still firing at another component would be cleared while its cause stands (Law 7).
traces_to: Law 7: a record of truth may not collapse an error into silence; a trouble cleared while its cause stands is that collapse.
how: _main calls _reconcile_cleared_findings only when no component was named; raises are unchanged. A red-first proof drives _main with a scripted inspect, an empty scratch baseline and a recording raiser.
